budget_items.what_was_said: Station manager said the line is at the very top of its budgeted amount, driven by the Castus fee and other POs.
The yearly support fee is rising; the reseller estimated an increase, and a streaming service for Zoom meetings adds a further cost.
The station ended last year at a stated balance that carried forward as this year's start, after a reconciliation error from a wrong July 2021 starting balance was found.
A heavy monthly expense in July is indirect costs, taken out first in the year.
Equipment line is nearly used up so the purchase would come from new equipment; members discussed prices and a spending cap so the manager can shop for quotes.
Because the purchase is large, the manager must obtain several quotes and justify the vendor chosen.

A motion to allow up to a set amount for new Macintosh computer equipment was made; the outcome was not audible, and the manager is to get several quotes.
Meetings are to return to 6 p.m. on the first Monday of the month, moving to the second Monday for holidays or weather.
The committee discussed an unauthorized personal Zoom account used for a building committee meeting; a member will email the town so only town accounts are used.
The station manager reported the equipment maintenance line is at the top of its budget, with a rising yearly support fee for the Castus system.

why_it_matters: The studio's equipment line is nearly used up and a support fee is rising, so the Mac purchase and any air conditioning work touch the cable access budget residents' cable fees help fund.
The Zoom account question and the library as a possible meeting place bear on how and where residents can watch or attend town meetings.

The town's reply to the email about unauthorized Zoom use and the air conditioning request.
